name: Yuuki Kotoha
source:
She is the youngest daughter of an old and prominent family. She is forbidden to touch a man  She is prohibited from so much as touching a man prior to marriage. 

To demonstrate her understanding of male physiological needs she orders her fiancé, Asato, to use the body of her handmaid in place of having an affair.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_134.html#character]official site[/url]]
